app.title: Digital Credential Platform
app.description: Digital credential platform. Issue, verify, and share certificates using the Open Badges standard.

verifyPage.ob3Desc: Open Badges 3.0 is an open standard for digital credentials that is not tied to any specific platform or organization.
verifyPage.instantDesc: Get immediate verification results with detailed certificate information
verifyPage.formatsDesc: Support for various certificate formats including Open Badges and Verifiable Credentials

faq.a1: Our verification system checks the certificate's digital signature and metadata according to the Open Badges 3.0 standard. This ensures the certificate is authentic, untampered, and issued by a legitimate authority.
faq.q2: What types of certificates can I verify?
faq.a2: You can verify any digital certificate issued through {brand}, including Open Badges 3.0 and other compatible verifiable credentials.
faq.a3: Yes. We use the Open Badges 3.0 standard, which makes each credential tamper-evident and verifiable. All data is processed securely and transparently.
faq.a4: Verification is instant in most cases: the system checks authenticity and validity with the Open Badges 3.0 protocol and returns results within seconds.
faq.q5: What information is shown in the verification results?
faq.a5: Results include the certificate's status, issuer details, issue date, expiration date (if any) and the Open Badges 3.0 verification proof. You can also view the full certificate details if available.

linkedin.title: Add your credential to LinkedIn
linkedin.intro: Share what you learned in the licenses and certifications section of your profile.

linkedin.step3: Include its verification link. Make sure the public link is active so others can view it.
